title: BatleHub Java project configuration
description: The team's committed configuration of a Java workspace (RFC 0006), read by the editor and by the headless engine. Every key is optional: absent means the team did not say, and the developer's settings or detection decide.

version.description: The format's version; this java-core reads 1.

requirement.description: The Java major version the project needs, e.g. "21"; overrides what pom.xml or build.gradle ask for. Absent: the build tool decides.

configuration.description: The Maven configuration to use: a name from maven.configurations here, from batlehub.java.maven.configurations, or a detected ~/.m2/settings*.xml.

configurations.description: Named Maven configurations, the same shape as batlehub.java.maven.configurations. A committed settingsFile is announced before it is used.

activeProfiles.description: Maven profiles: -P on every goal and the m2e preference.
Reserved: Gradle has no profiles; kept so the file has one shape per tool.

enabled.description: Whether Maven and Gradle resolve through BatleHub: ask, true, or false (a public repository can say never).

satellites.description: One object per satellite id, each with its own schema; a satellite that is not installed keeps its section.
